title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Circus Maximus Theater, Atlantic City | 2010
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Circus Maximus Theater at Caesars in Atlantic City, New Jersey, USA, on 3 July 2010.

It was the eighth show of the 11th All-Starr Band’s tour of North America, which lasted for 31 dates between June and August 2010.

Starr had previously performed at the Circus Maximus Theater on 21, 22, and 23 July 1995. He returned there on 23 June 2012 and 21 June 2014.

The 11th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Wally Palmar: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Rick Derringer: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Gary Wright: vocals, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
